technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure create potential reversal setup, but absence of price confirmation above key moving averages, bearish candlestick pattern, and weak trend strength make this a low-probability entry.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 183 crisis regime) combined with critical earnings binary event in 5 days create extreme risk environment for AMGN positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) combined with supertrend bullish signal and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment create textbook reversal setup near support at 229.66.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 5 days, VIX crisis regime, inverted yield curve, price below all short-term MAs, three black crows pattern, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a high-risk low-probability entry into macro headwinds.
